definitions: Thick, soft, wet mud or a similar viscous mixture of liquid and solid components, especially the product of an industrial or refining process.
A muddy or slushy mass, often found at the bottom of a body of water or in a drain.
examples: The river was choked with industrial sludge.
They had to clear the sludge from the pipes.
A thick layer of sludge covered the bottom of the tank.
